mapper.select: select sum(Sep_Days) from Sec_Expert_Pause mn where mn.Ex_Id=#{exId} and mn.State=7

select ex.Ex_Name as exName, ex.Ex_Id_Type as exIdType, ex.Ex_Id_Number as exIdNumber, ex.Ex_Plaintext_Num as exPlaintextNum, ex.Ex_Age as exAge, c1.C_Name as cName, c1.C_Abbreviation as cAbbName, c1.C_Name_History as cNameHistory, mn.* from Sec_Expert_Pause mn left join Sec_Expert ex on mn.Ex_Id = ex.Ex_Id left join Sys_Company c1 on c1.C_Id=ex.C_Id where mn.id = #{id}
